description.narrative:
Drawing on Oxfam in Laos' past and ongoing projects, this initiative builds upon established experiences and lessons learned to empower women for climate-resilient livelihoods and economic empowerment, while integrating new activities related to safe migration and enhancing women and female youth participation in community decision-making processes. Oxfam in Laos will lead coordination efforts, ensuring donor compliance, reporting, and project monitoring and evaluation, while ARMI will serve as the project's implementing partner, with defined roles and responsibilities. In addition, this proposed project focuses on strengthening women-led organisations and CSOs, empowering them to tackle the specific challenges faced by marginalized women and youth in project target areas. With this collaborative and practical approach, the project is not just making a difference now but setting the stage for sustainable change in the long run.
The two parties undertake to execute their activities to achieve the following specific objective:
1) Improved entrepreneurial and leadership skills among women and female youth involved in agricultural businesses through tailored capacity-building sessions and networking opportunities, contributing to their effective operation and growth. 2) Integrated activities to ensure that women and female youth received technical capacity and financial support to enhance their skills and to operate their agricultural businesses. 3) Enabled and empowered in Laos’ vulnerable communities by promoting gender equality and equal distribution of care work responsibilities in the community. 4) Increase the knowledge and the awareness of community members regarding gender equality, climate change resilience, domestic violence and importanceof care work conducted increased. 5) Ensure that women are capacitatedand confident to disseminate information on gender equality, equal distribution of care work.

participating-org.narrative:
Oxfam has had a presence in Lao PDR for longer than most INGOs, with both Oxfam in Belgium (OBE) and Oxfam Australia (OAU) beginning programming and establishing offices in the late 1980s. Oxfam’s vision is of a Laos in which all citizens – particularlywomen, the marginalised and discriminated groups – are able to claim their right to access opportunities and resources so as to overcome all forms of poverty and injustice.
Since 2015, the work of Oxfam in the country is governed by the Oxfam Country Strategy (2015-2019).We seek transformative changes in policies, practices and beliefs in ways that fundamentally improve the lives of poor and marginalised women and men, and ensure that all citizens have the same opportunities to enjoy their rights. Todo so, Oxfam focuses its work on four Domains of Change: Citizen Participation and Civil Society Development, Gender Justice, Resilient Communities and Sustainable Development, and Responsible Investment.
For this project, Oxfam in Laos will support theexpansion of the influencing work and public campaign on advocating for more inclusive social protection and access to social protection of the most marginalized workers. National public events will be organised, such Eliminate Violence Against Women Day(EVAW), and digital platforms will be used to socialize the information, and stir discussion and dialogue among rights holders, government stakeholders and policy makers. The campaigns will be implemented nationwide and in the provinces where Oxfam in Laos works. Target groups include marginalized workers, youth,women, CSOs as well as government stakeholders.
